chapterInfo.content:
27
Selofehad mmammaa kyɛfa ho asɛm
1 # Num 26.33; 36.2; Yos 17.3-6 Na Manase ba Makir ba Gilead ba Hefer ba Selofehad mmammaa a wɔwɔ Yosef ba Manase mmusua mu no twe pinii; na ne mmammaa no din ne Mahla, Noa, Hogla, Milka ne Tirsa. 2Na wɔbɛgyinaa Mose ne Ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa ne mmapɔmma no ne asafo mu no nyinaa anim, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano kaa sɛ: 3#Num 16.2; 26.65 Yɛn agya wuu ɛserɛ so, nso ɔno deɛ, na ɔmfra asafo a wɔhyia tiaa AWURADE, Kora asafo no mu, na ɔno ara ne bɔne nti na ɔwuiɛ; nso na ɔnni mmammarima. 4Adɛn nti na yɛn agya din mpepa mfiri n’abusua mu ɛnam sɛ ɔnni babarima nti? Ma yɛn agyapadeɛ yɛn agya ne nuanom mu. 5#Lew 24.12 Na Mose de wɔn asɛm no baa AWURADE anim.
6Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 7Selofehad mmammaa asɛm no tene, na ma wɔn agyapadeɛ na wɔnni so wɔn agya nuanom mu, na ma wɔn agya agyapadeɛ no nyɛ wɔn dea. 8Na kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ: Sɛ ɔbarima bi wu na ɔnni babarima a, ɛnneɛ momma n’agyapadeɛ nyɛ ne babaa deɛ. 9Na sɛ ɔnni babaa nso a, ɛnneɛ momfa n’agyapadeɛ mma ne nuammarimanom; 10na sɛ ɔnni nuabarima nso a, momfa n’agyapadeɛ mma n’agya nuanom. 11Na sɛ n’agya nni nuanom nso a, momfa n’agyapadeɛ mma ne bogya a ɔbɛn no n’abusua mu na ɔnni so. Na yei nyɛ ahyɛdeɛ ne mmara mma Israelfoɔ, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.
Wɔyi Yosua sɛ Israel kannifoɔ
(Deuteronomium 31.1-8)
12 # Deut 32.48-49 Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Foro Abarim bepɔ yi na kɔhwɛ asase a mede merema Israelfoɔ no; 13#Num 20.24, 28 na sɛ wonya hunu a, wo nso woati wo nananom, sɛdeɛ Aaron tii n’agyanom no, 14#Num 20.12-13 ɛfiri sɛ moyɛɛ m’asɛm ho asoɔden Sin serɛ so, asafo no ham mu a anka ɛsɛ sɛ moyɛ me kronkron, nsuo no ho wɔ wɔn ani soɔ no. (Ɛne ɔham nsuo no wɔ Kades, Sin serɛ so.) 15Na Mose kasa kyerɛɛ AWURADE sɛ: 16#Num 16.22 Ma AWURADE, honam nyinaa ahonhom Nyankopɔn, mpɛ ɔbarima bi nsi asafo no so 17#Mat 9.36 a ɔbɛdi wɔn anim afiri adie na ɔbɛdi wɔn anim aba mu, deɛ ɔde wɔn bɛfiri adie na ɔde wɔn aba mu, na AWURADE asafo no anyɛ sɛ nnwan a wɔnni hwɛfoɔ.
18 # Deut 3.21; 34.9 Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Fa Nun ba Yosua, ɔbarima a honhom wɔ ne mu no, na fa wo nsa gu ne so. 19Na fa no gyina Ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa ne asafo mu no nyinaa anim, na hyɛ no mmara wɔn anim; 20#2 Ah 2.9, 15 na fa w’animuonyam no bi hyɛ no, na Israelfoɔ asafo mu no nyinaa ntie no. 21#Eks 28.30 Na ɔnkɔgyina Ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa anim, na ɔmmisa urim atemmuo mma no, AWURADE anim; wɔmfa n’asɛm so mfiri adi, na wɔmfa n’asɛm so mmra mu, ɔno ne Israelfoɔ a wɔka ne ho nyinaa, ne asafo mu no nyinaa. 22Na Mose yɛɛ sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ no no, na ɔfaa Yosua de no kɔgyinaa Ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa ne asafo mu no nyinaa anim, 23na ɔde ne nsa guu ne so na ɔhyɛɛ no mmara, sɛdeɛ AWURADE nam Mose so kaeɛ no.

Na Manase ba Makir ba Gilead ba Hefer ba Selofehad mmammaa a wɔwɔ Yosef ba Manase mmusua mu no twe pinii; na ne mmammaa no din ne Mahla, Noa, Hogla, Milka ne Tirsa. Na wɔbɛgyinaa Mose ne Ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa ne mmapɔmma no ne asafo mu no nyinaa anim, ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ano kaa sɛ: Yɛn agya wuu ɛserɛ so, nso ɔno deɛ, na ɔmfra asafo a wɔhyia tiaa AWURADE, Kora asafo no mu, na ɔno ara ne bɔne nti na ɔwuiɛ; nso na ɔnni mmammarima. Adɛn nti na yɛn agya din mpepa mfiri n’abusua mu ɛnam sɛ ɔnni babarima nti? Ma yɛn agyapadeɛ yɛn agya ne nuanom mu. Na Mose de wɔn asɛm no baa AWURADE anim.
Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Selofehad mmammaa asɛm no tene, na ma wɔn agyapadeɛ na wɔnni so wɔn agya nuanom mu, na ma wɔn agya agyapadeɛ no nyɛ wɔn dea. Na kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no sɛ: Sɛ ɔbarima bi wu na ɔnni babarima a, ɛnneɛ momma n’agyapadeɛ nyɛ ne babaa deɛ. Na sɛ ɔnni babaa nso a, ɛnneɛ momfa n’agyapadeɛ mma ne nuammarimanom; na sɛ ɔnni nuabarima nso a, momfa n’agyapadeɛ mma n’agya nuanom. Na sɛ n’agya nni nuanom nso a, momfa n’agyapadeɛ mma ne bogya a ɔbɛn no n’abusua mu na ɔnni so. Na yei nyɛ ahyɛdeɛ ne mmara mma Israelfoɔ, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Mose no.


Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Foro Abarim bepɔ yi na kɔhwɛ asase a mede merema Israelfoɔ no; na sɛ wonya hunu a, wo nso woati wo nananom, sɛdeɛ Aaron tii n’agyanom no, ɛfiri sɛ moyɛɛ m’asɛm ho asoɔden Sin serɛ so, asafo no ham mu a anka ɛsɛ sɛ moyɛ me kronkron, nsuo no ho wɔ wɔn ani soɔ no. (Ɛne ɔham nsuo no wɔ Kades, Sin serɛ so.) Na Mose kasa kyerɛɛ AWURADE sɛ: Ma AWURADE, honam nyinaa ahonhom Nyankopɔn, mpɛ ɔbarima bi nsi asafo no so a ɔbɛdi wɔn anim afiri adie na ɔbɛdi wɔn anim aba mu, deɛ ɔde wɔn bɛfiri adie na ɔde wɔn aba mu, na AWURADE asafo no anyɛ sɛ nnwan a wɔnni hwɛfoɔ.
Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Fa Nun ba Yosua, ɔbarima a honhom wɔ ne mu no, na fa wo nsa gu ne so. Na fa no gyina Ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa ne asafo mu no nyinaa anim, na hyɛ no mmara wɔn anim; na fa w’animuonyam no bi hyɛ no, na Israelfoɔ asafo mu no nyinaa ntie no. Na ɔnkɔgyina Ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa anim, na ɔmmisa urim atemmuo mma no, AWURADE anim; wɔmfa n’asɛm so mfiri adi, na wɔmfa n’asɛm so mmra mu, ɔno ne Israelfoɔ a wɔka ne ho nyinaa, ne asafo mu no nyinaa. Na Mose yɛɛ sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ no no, na ɔfaa Yosua de no kɔgyinaa Ɔsɔfoɔ Eleasa ne asafo mu no nyinaa anim, na ɔde ne nsa guu ne so na ɔhyɛɛ no mmara, sɛdeɛ AWURADE nam Mose so kaeɛ no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
